title: Ultimate Tic/Tac/Toe
shortDescription: Nine boards. One big win. Play tic-tac-toe with a strategy twist.
fullDescription:
Nine boards. One big win.

Tic-tac-toe, with a twist. Every move sends your opponent to their next mini-board. Win three small boards in a row to take the whole game.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Challenge the computer at Easy, Medium, or Hard difficulty.
• Pass the phone for a local two-player match.
• Play offline with no account or internet connection.

THINK ABOUT THE NEXT BOARD
Your square determines your opponent's next board. If that board is finished, they may choose any open board. Highlighted destinations and winning lines help you see the next move.

KEEP YOUR MOMENTUM
• Undo local moves.
• Replay the moves in your current game.
• Track local wins and draws on your device.
• Switch between light, dark, and system appearance.
• Learn the rules with an optional first-run introduction.

Free to play. This initial Android version does not contain ads or in-app purchases.

One board is never enough.
